title: Reduce AND TRUE FALSE
description: This Church-boolean reduction lets TRUE select the second argument, FALSE.

steps.description: AND takes TRUE as p and leaves a lambda waiting for q. Its body uses p to choose between q and p.
Applying that lambda to FALSE produces TRUE FALSE TRUE.

steps.question: Which argument does the Church TRUE selector keep here?
steps.answer: TRUE keeps its first argument, FALSE.

steps.description: Expanding TRUE shows it selects FALSE and discards the final TRUE. The normal form is FALSE.
